title: PCA Algorithm Intuition: Reducing Dimensions in Unsupervised Learning

cues.en: -: Welcome to Section 34, "Principle Component Analysis" or PCA.
cues.zh: 歡迎來到第 34 節，主成分分析，也就是 PCA。

cues.en: Before you get some hands on experience coming up with PCA in the practical exercises, we're gonna take a look at the intuition behind it.
cues.zh: 在實作練習中親自使用 PCA 前，先看看背後的直覺。

cues.en: PCA is considered to be one of the most used unsupervised algorithms, and can be seen as the most popular dimensionality reduction algorithm.
cues.zh: PCA 是最常使用的非監督式演算法之一，也可視為最熱門的降維演算法。

cues.en: PCA is used for operations such as visualization, feature extraction, noise filtering, and can be seen in algorithms used for stock market predictions,
cues.zh: PCA 可用於視覺化、特徵擷取、雜訊過濾，也能在股票市場預測

cues.en: and gene analysis, just to name a few.
cues.zh: 與基因分析等演算法中看到它，這只是幾個例子。

cues.en: The goal of PCA is to identify and detect correlation between variables.
cues.zh: PCA 的目標，是找出並偵測變數之間的相關性。

cues.en: If there's a strong correlation and it's found, then you could reduce the dimensionality which really what PCA is intended for.
cues.zh: 如果找到強烈相關性，就能降低維度，這正是 PCA 的用途。

cues.en: You find the directions of maximum variance in high dimensional data, and then you project it into a smaller dimensional subspace, while retaining most of the information.
cues.zh: 在高維資料中找出變異最大的方向，再將資料投影到較低維的子空間，同時保留大部分資訊。

cues.en: Usually, again, with PCA, the goal to reduce the dimensions of a D-dimensional data set by projecting it onto a K-dimensional subspace,
cues.zh: 通常 PCA 的目標，是將 D 維資料集投影到 K 維子空間，來降低維度，

cues.en: where K is less than D.
cues.zh: 其中 K 小於 D。

cues.en: And for a overall breakdown and wrap up of the PCA we can see here that the main functions of the PCA algorithm
cues.zh: 整體整理一下，這裡可以看到 PCA 演算法的主要步驟，

cues.en: would be to standardize the data, obtain the eigenvectors and eigenvalues, to then sort the eigenvalues in descending order,
cues.zh: 包括標準化資料、取得特徵向量與特徵值，再將特徵值依遞減順序排列，

cues.en: construct the projection matrix W from the selected K eigenvectors, and to transform the original data set.
cues.zh: 從選出的 K 個特徵向量建立投影矩陣 W，再轉換原始資料集。

cues.en: And you can explore it further if you follow that link.
cues.zh: 可以透過這個連結進一步探索。

cues.en: But one thing I want to examine here with PCA and I think the visualization is really helpful, if we visit the following link, it's gonna take us to this page
cues.zh: 不過這裡有個想特別看看之處，我認為視覺化很有幫助。開啟以下連結，會進入這個頁面，

cues.en: where we can actually view it in 2D and 3D examples.
cues.zh: 可以查看二維與三維範例。

cues.en: Now, with PCA, in a 2D you can start to see the relationship and how PCA is playing out amongst the variables and the data.
cues.zh: 二維例子裡，能開始看出變數、資料的關係，以及 PCA 如何作用。

cues.en: You can also, on this site, drag them around, drag the data points around to see the PCA coordinates adjust within the system.
cues.zh: 這個網站也可以拖動資料點，觀察系統內 PCA 座標如何調整。

cues.en: But really what I think is helpful is the 3D example.
cues.zh: 但我認為三維例子更有幫助。

cues.en: With the 3D example, you can actually see the relationship the data within this model.
cues.zh: 三維例子裡，可以實際看到模型內的資料關係。

cues.en: Comparing it to the 2D within the higher dimensional space, obviously, it can be a much easier visualization, and I think this is helpful really to kinda grasp what PCA is doing.
cues.zh: 把高維空間的情況與二維相比，這樣視覺化顯然更容易，也有助於掌握 PCA 的作用。

cues.en: And if we drag the data points around again, just for a test, we can click on the show PCA, should we reset that,
cues.zh: 再拖動資料點來測試，按 Show PCA，先重設一下，

cues.en: and we'll show it.
cues.zh: 再將它顯示出來。

cues.en: And we can see the PCA here.
cues.zh: 這裡就能看到 PCA。

cues.en: We can actually move the model around.
cues.zh: 也可以轉動模型。

cues.en: Since it's not on that 2D plot, we can visualize it within the 3D example.
cues.zh: 因為不再侷限於二維圖，可以在三維例子裡觀察。

cues.en: All right, so to wrap PCA up short and sweet.
cues.zh: 好，簡單總結 PCA。

cues.en: PCA is not like linear regression, although it may look like it, because rather than attempting to predict the values, PCA is attempting to learn about the relationship
cues.zh: PCA 不是線性迴歸，雖然看起來可能很像；它不是嘗試預測數值，而是學習

cues.en: between the X and Y values.
cues.zh: X、Y 數值之間的關係。

cues.en: It's quantified by finding a list of principle axis.
cues.zh: 透過找出一組主軸，將關係量化。

cues.en: And I think one of the best ways is to look at the visualizations, compare it to 2D and 3D dimension, the analysis and the visualizations that we looked at before.
cues.zh: 我認為最好的方式之一，就是看看前面的視覺化，對照二維、三維的分析與呈現。

cues.en: In addition, on a side note, PCA does have a weakness.
cues.zh: 另外補充，PCA 也有弱點。

cues.en: It is highly affected by outliers in the data but PCA is considered to be one of the most used, and it's extremely popular to use,
cues.zh: 它很容易受資料中的離群值影響，但仍是最常用、非常熱門的演算法之一。

cues.en: and I think once you start working through the practical it'll make more sense.
cues.zh: 開始做實作之後，你應該會更理解。

cues.en: If you have any questions please let us know, and enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 有任何問題，請告訴我們，享受機器學習的樂趣吧。
